name: Ayumi Tanaka
bio:
Ayumi Tanaka's motorsport journey began unexpectedly. While working for a major automotive manufacturer in Japan, she became fascinated by the data acquisition systems used in their racing program. Her analytical skills and keen eye for detail quickly made her an invaluable asset, and she transitioned into a full-time performance engineering role. Her approach is meticulous, focusing on extracting every last bit of performance through careful analysis and iterative improvements. 

At Reiza Racing Academy, Ayumi's experience has been crucial in bridging the gap between raw talent and consistent results. She has a knack for explaining complex data in a way that drivers can understand and apply, fostering a strong working relationship built on trust and mutual respect. Her loyalty to the team and dedication to her craft are well-known, making her a respected figure within the organization.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave and parted to the side.
physical.description: Ayumi is a petite woman with a kind smile and intelligent eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten technical notes.
Insists on drinking green tea from a specific ceramic mug during races.
Has a habit of adjusting her glasses even when they are perfectly in place.
